name: Hostel — lobby & corridor loop
description: Real capture with the team's PoseCam app (Nothing Phone A059, ARCore poses). Photoreal view: a Gaussian splat trained with Nerfstudio splatfacto (30,000 steps) directly on the PoseCam frames and ARCore poses (no COLMAP); PSNR 24.5 dB on 137 held-out frames. Points view: per-frame metric depth (1,376 frames) placed with the ARCore poses. The walked path counts as observed floor.
